exposure: curettage combined with ultrasound-guided sclerosant injection (USI)
outcome: time for serum beta human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG) to reduce to normal
cohort: 72 patients with CSP undergoing curettage combined with USI and 72 patients with CSP undergoing curettage following UAE.
finding: For treatment of CSP, curettage combined with USI yielded clinical results comparable to those of curettage following UAE.
